question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Resolute
solution:
The correct answer is '**Wavering**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's go through the meanings of the words and then select the appropriate **antonym** for "**resolute**": 

 
 
• **Serious** (गंभीर) - solemn or thoughtful in character or manner.
 
• **Wavering** (अस्थिर) - moving back and forth; indecisive or uncertain.
 
• **Steadfast** (निर्दयी) - firm, unwavering, or determined in purpose or loyalty.
 
• **Brave** (बहादुर) - showing courage or bravery; not afraid to face danger or difficulty. 
 
 
 
• Among these options, the most appropriate antonym for "**resolute**" is: **Wavering**.
 
• "**Resolute**" means** admirably purposeful, determined, and unwavering.** It indicates firmness of **purpose or determination**. The opposite of being resolute would be to waver, which means **to be indecisive or uncertain, lacking firmness or determination.** Therefore,** "wavering" (option 2) **is the correct antonym in this context.
 
• ***Sentence using the correct option:__ **Despite facing numerous challenges, she remained **resolute** in her decision to pursue her dreams.*
